_doc: Stage 1 of the Florida-to-Bahamas map (docs/world-bimini): Biscayne Bay to Bimini across the Gulf Stream, about 50 nm, as one streamed world. Composed by Tools/coast/compose_world.py (build_coast.py MiamiBimini) from three bakes: MiamiBiscayne (the frame, 10 m), Bimini (10 m) and FloridaStraits (200 m, deep tiles in 5 cm steps). The Gulf Stream: Tools/coast/gulf_stream.py MiamiBimini -> MiamiBimini.stream. Positions are lat/lon (NAD83).
name: MiamiBimini
display: Miami to Bimini, across the Gulf Stream

gulf_stream._note: the analytic Florida Current's numbers (gulf_stream.py DEFAULTS); replaced by model monthly means with --nc once the Mac fetches them

launch: Off Fowey Rocks, bound for Bimini
